criteria.U1: [D] undisturbed standing 60 s with motor noise: no fall (COM within 100 mm of entry, pelvis drop < 150 mm), no stop
criteria.U2: [D/S] first 250 ms with P2 running: load steps 1–4 within ±10 % BW and steps 5–60 within ±1 %; penetration and separation ≤ 1 mm; COP within 5 mm of the COM projection from step 5; pelvis ≤ 1 mm, COM ≤ 2 mm, key-axis drift ≤ 0.5°
criteria.U3: [D] no slow fold or creep: last-10-s mean vs 1–2 s mean — every key axis ≤ 3°, pelvis drop ≤ 10 mm, COM shift ≤ 15 mm
criteria.U4: [M/E] alive but bounded: COM sway RMS AP within [1.0, 12.9] mm and ML within [0.43, 6.0] mm (human 4.1–4.3 / 1.7–2.0 mm, Foulger 2025, × [0.25, 3] for this wider, flexed stance)
criteria.U5: [S] separation ≤ 5 mm transient and penetration ≤ 1 mm over 60 s
criteria.P1: small pushes (4 directions): recovered without a step (no fall; COM within 10 mm of the undisturbed twin over the last 1 s; pelvis < 10 mm)
criteria.P2: moderate pushes (4 directions): recovered without a step
criteria.P3: large pushes (4 directions; 1.5 × the zero-delay limit): loss of no-step balance within 4 s — a controller that saves everything fails
criteria.P4: continuum: COM peak excursion strictly increases small < moderate < large in every direction
criteria.P5: [causality] every push: P2 commands bit-identical to the undisturbed twin until the disturbance reaches P2's delayed sensory state; first command difference ≥ onset + 1 step + the shortest channel delay (6 steps = 25 ms); first activation difference not before the first command difference
criteria.P6: [M] latency: first neural torque change (> 0.1 N·m) at ankle / knee / hip / lumbar ≥ 60 ms after onset (earliest automatic postural EMG) and ≤ 200 ms for moderate pushes (active torque 100–160 ms, Horak 1989; Robinovitch 2002)
criteria.M1: [M/E] Rietdyk-form pushes (20 N·s over 350 ms, AP and ML): recovered; COM peak within [24, 120] mm (Rietdyk 1999: 56–70 mm, × [0.4, 2]); time to peak within [0.25, 1.0] s; settled (within 10 mm) by 3.5 s (human 2–3 s)
criteria.T1: [M/E] no-step failure threshold (50 ms pelvis pulse): forward within [8.5, 19.4] N·s and lateral within [21.8, 49.8] N·s (= [0.35, 0.80] × this stance's zero-delay XcoM limit; humans step at ≈ 0.44–0.56)
criteria.DET: [S] bit-identical reruns (4 s standing, moderate forward push)
